title: Turkey Stuffing Casserole
ingredients: Cream of chicken soup + sour cream
steps:
Turkey + frozen veggies
in a greased 9x13

Soup + sour cream on top,
then the Swiss

Stuffing over everything.
375°F: 20 min covered,
15 uncovered, to 165°F
vo: Leftover stuffing and leftover turkey? Together they make a whole new casserole.
You need about three cups each of cooked turkey and stuffing, a can of cream of chicken soup, sour cream, frozen mixed vegetables and shredded Swiss cheese.
Spread the turkey and frozen vegetables in a greased nine by thirteen dish.
Stir the soup and sour cream together, spread it over the top, and sprinkle on the Swiss.
Scatter the stuffing over everything. Cover and bake at three seventy-five for twenty minutes, then uncover for fifteen more, until the center reaches one sixty-five degrees.
